# log

jvm

open override fun [log](log.html)(level: [Level](../-level/index.html), cause: [Throwable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-throwable/index.html)?, msg: () -> [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html))

Logs a message at the specified [level](log.html).

#### Parameters

 _level_

The severity level of the log message.

_cause_

An optional [Throwable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-throwable/index.html) to log along with the message.

_msg_

A lambda returning the string message to log. It is only evaluated if the given [level](log.html) is enabled.
